summary: Added a bounded executable mechanical-enforcement validator and deterministic fail-closed regression covering required gate presence, validator binding, pre-claim-ready application and fail-closed semantics. The regression passed locally in Node. The current compiled-dispatch owner is a large file and this runtime's GitHub Contents mutation surface only supports complete-file replacement; without a bounded patch/checkout path, wiring the new validator into validateCompiledDispatchContract would require an unsafe blind full-owner rewrite. The unit therefore returns SAFE_PARTIAL rather than falsely claiming the adversarial benchmark miss is closed.
